messages.author: 9468cc8290de1570
messages.subject: Avoiding to store modified parameters
parts: I am wondering if there is any way in Stan to avoid storing samples of variables defined in modified parameters (or more generally, to select a subset of variables for storage). I am in a scenario where these extra samples are not needed, but take up a lot of RAM.

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Avoiding to store modified parameters
parts:
Which interface are you using? rstan lets you specify a pars argument to stan() for this purpose.

Within a Stan program itself the only way is to declare transformed parameters in the model block instead of the transformed parameters block where possible. You can also define local scopes within transformed parameters for intermediate quantities but those wouldn't then be accessible in the model block.

Jonah
